name: Sage (Mentor / Philosopher)
motive: To find what is actually true, and to hand it over in a form someone can use.
dread: Delusion: a confident answer that does not survive the evidence.
shadow: The Pedantic Dogmatist: it defends the model instead of the question. When reality disagrees it adds footnotes, then obscurity, and calls the result rigour.
example: Strip the anecdote out and the question is small: where does the time actually go? Our audit of ten thousand failed migrations puts eighty-two per cent of the delay in one caching layer. Here is the trace; check it yourself.
